entry_state: Chapter 6 has defined compatibility, answer families, accounting invariants, simulation, probability and computational limits. Its root-finding, Bayesian and Gaussian examples distinguish numerical validity from information identity and accounting authority; its causal example distinguishes stress, observation and intervention. The undefined theta remains the sole confirmed new defect. The language chapter must now encode these semantics in portable declarations and checks.
exit_state: The language separates preserved Core 0 teaching syntax from proposed portable records and compilation. Exact values, unknowns, contexts, dependency identity and capability checks give the earlier mathematics enforceable boundaries. The debt listing retains a shared continuous family and posting rules require explicit applicability; the discussion of alternatives and evidence updates continues on the next page.
findings: The corrected Section 7.4 pointer reaches the proposed portable compilation sequence. Historical Core 0 execution planning is explicitly separate from the portable compiler.
Type distinctions preserve currency, timing, shared unknowns, probability and measurement status. Missing, zero and not-applicable values have different import meanings.
Portable record identity has explicit rational, integer, Unicode, ordering and byte rules. Its digest concerns representation, not economic equivalence or source truth.

The first company profile cannot admit a real company by dropping unsupported subsidiaries, leases or contingencies. Typed whole-company authoring and the initially bounded text frontend have separate scope.
The illustrative debt and posting listings are legible and their shared symbols, unsupported negative interest and tie rules are explained. No additional confirmed defect.

equation.exposition_role: Mechanism-bearing engineering definition of portable record identity.
equation.symbols_units_domain: UTF8 encodes the version/schema prefix; 0x00 separates it from canonical(record); SHA256 operates on the resulting byte sequence.
equation.assumptions_timing: Canonical rules reject floats, duplicates and invalid scalars, preserve decoded code points and order non-set arrays.
equation.source_and_equality: Exact stipulated encoding/hash construction; no cryptographic uniqueness proof or semantic-equivalence theorem is claimed.
equation.interpretation: Formatting-equivalent admitted encodings can share identity; different Unicode composition remains distinct unless an explicit transformation relates it.
equation.transition: Legacy conversion preserves original bytes and identifiers alongside declared portable outputs.
